  ArrowDown02Icon,
  ArrowUp01Icon,
  Cancel01Icon,
  LeftToRightListBulletIcon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";

import type { IconSvgElement } from "@hugeicons/react";

  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type RunLogStatus = "ok" | "error" | "running";

export type RunLogTime = Date | string | number;

export interface RunLogRun {
  id: string;
  /** What was asked, or any name for the run. */
  name: string;
  /** Defaults to `ok`. */
  status?: RunLogStatus;
  /** The model id the run used, such as `claude-sonnet-5-5`. */
  model?: string;
  startedAt?: RunLogTime;
  /** A running run counts up from `startedAt` when this is left out. */
  durationMs?: number;
  costUsd?: number;
  /** Why the run failed, in one line. Shown under the name. */
  error?: string;
}

const clean = (value: number | undefined): number =>
  value !== undefined && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.max(0, value) : 0;

const trimDecimal = (value: number): string => {
  const rounded = Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
  return Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : rounded.toFixed(1);
};

/** `840ms`, `4.1s`, `2m 05s`. */
export const formatRunDuration = (ms: number): string => {
  const value = clean(ms);
  if (value < 1000) {
    return `${Math.round(value)}ms`;
  }
  if (value < 60_000) {
    return `${trimDecimal(value / 1000)}s`;
  }
  const seconds = Math.round(value / 1000);
  return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, "0")}s`;
};

/** `$0`, `<$0.01`, `$0.21`, `$12.40`, `$1,240`. */
export const formatRunCost = (cost: number): string => {
  const value = clean(cost);
  if (value === 0) {
    return "$0";
  }
  if (value < 0.01) {
    return "<$0.01";
  }
  if (value < 1000) {
    return `$${value.toFixed(2)}`;
  }
  return `$${Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-US")}`;
};

/** `search_logs`, `searchLogs`, and `search-logs` all read as `Search logs`. */
const toolLabel = (name: string): string => {
  const words = name
    .replaceAll(/[_-]+/gu, " ")
    .replaceAll(/([a-z\d])([A-Z])/gu, "$1 $2")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase();
  return words ? `${words.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${words.slice(1)}` : name;
};

type UsageInput = Pick<LanguageModelUsage, "inputTokens" | "outputTokens">;

/** The parts of an AI SDK `StepResult` a row needs. */
export interface RunLogStepSource {
  usage?: UsageInput;
  model?: { modelId?: string };
  finishReason?: string;
  performance?: {
    stepTimeMs?: number;
    responseTimeMs?: number;
    toolExecutionMs?: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
  };
  toolCalls?: readonly { toolCallId: string; toolName: string }[];
  /** Read for `tool-error` parts. */
  content?: readonly { type: string; toolCallId?: string; error?: unknown }[];
}

/** US dollars per million tokens. */
export interface RunLogPrice {
  input: number;
  output: number;
}

const PER_MILLION = 1_000_000;

const firstLine = (error: unknown): string => {
  let text = "";
  if (typeof error === "string") {
    text = error;
  } else if (error instanceof Error) {
    text = error.message;
  }
  return text.split("\n")[0]?.trim() ?? "";
};

const stepMs = (step: RunLogStepSource): number => {
  const tools = Object.values(step.performance?.toolExecutionMs ?? {});
  return Math.max(
    clean(step.performance?.stepTimeMs),
    clean(step.performance?.responseTimeMs) + Math.max(0, ...tools)
  );
};

const stepFailure = (
  step: RunLogStepSource,
  labels: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined
): string | null => {
  const failure = step.content?.find((part) => part.type === "tool-error");
  if (failure) {
    const tool = step.toolCalls?.find(
      (call) => call.toolCallId === failure.toolCallId
    );
    const reason = firstLine(failure.error);
    const subject = tool
      ? `${labels?.[tool.toolName] ?? toolLabel(tool.toolName)} failed`
      : "A tool failed";
    return reason ? `${subject}: ${reason}` : `${subject}.`;
  }
  return step.finishReason === "error" ? "The model returned an error." : null;
};

/**
 * One row from the steps of an AI SDK run: the model, how long the steps
 * took, what they cost at your prices, and the first tool error if there
 * was one. The same steps build the detail view with the Trace viewer's
 * `traceSpansFromSteps`.
 *
 * @example
 * const startedAt = Date.now();
 * const result = await generateText({ model, tools, prompt });
 * const run = runLogRun(result.steps, {
 *   id: result.response.id,
 *   name: prompt,
 *   prices: { "claude-sonnet-5-5": { input: 3, output: 15 } },
 *   startedAt,
 * });
 * // Store `run` and `result.steps`, then on the admin page:
 * <RunLog runs={runs} onSelect={(run) => openTrace(run.id)} />
 */
export const runLogRun = (
  steps: readonly RunLogStepSource[],
  options: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    startedAt?: RunLogTime;
    /** Display names for tools, keyed by tool name. Used in the failure reason. */
    labels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    /** Keyed by model id. Steps on a model without a price add no cost. */
    prices?: Readonly<Record<string, RunLogPrice>>;
  }
): RunLogRun => {
  let durationMs = 0;
  let costUsd: number | undefined;
  let error: string | null = null;
  for (const step of steps) {
    durationMs += stepMs(step);
    error ??= stepFailure(step, options.labels);
    const price = options.prices?.[step.model?.modelId ?? ""];
    if (price) {
      costUsd =
        (costUsd ?? 0) +
        (clean(step.usage?.inputTokens) * price.input +
          clean(step.usage?.outputTokens) * price.output) /
          PER_MILLION;
    }
  }
  return {
    costUsd,
    durationMs,
    error: error ?? undefined,
    id: options.id,
    model: steps.find((step) => step.model?.modelId)?.model?.modelId,
    name: options.name,
    startedAt: options.startedAt,
    status: error ? "error" : "ok",
  };
};

export type RunLogStatusFilter = "all" | "error" | "running";

export interface RunLogFilter {
  status: RunLogStatusFilter;
  /** A model id, or `null` for every model. */
  model: string | null;
}

export interface RunLogClassNames {
  root?: string;
  header?: string;
  filters?: string;
  columns?: string;
  list?: string;
  row?: string;
  footer?: string;
  detail?: string;
}

export interface RunLogProps {
  runs?: readonly RunLogRun[];
  title?: string;
  /** Shown beside the title, such as the time range the list covers. */
  caption?: string;
  /** Display names, keyed by model id. Shared with the Trace viewer. */
  labels?: Record<string, string>;
  /** Marks for the model column, keyed by model id. Shared with the Trace viewer. */
  icons?: Record<string, ReactNode>;
  /** The open run. Pass `null` for none. */
  selectedId?: string | null;
  defaultSelectedId?: string;
  /** Called when a run is opened. Makes rows pressable. */
  onSelect?: (run: RunLogRun) => void;
  /**
   * What the open run shows in the panel beside the list, such as its trace.
   * The panel has its own padding and scroll, so give the content no card of
   * its own.
   *
   * @example
   * renderDetail={(run) => (
   *   <TraceViewer
   *     className="rounded-none bg-transparent p-0 shadow-none hover:shadow-none"
   *     spans={traceSpansFromSteps(stepsByRun[run.id])}
   *     title={run.name}
   *   />
   * )}
   */
  renderDetail?: (run: RunLogRun) => ReactNode;
  /** Called when the panel is closed. */
  onClose?: () => void;
  defaultFilter?: Partial<RunLogFilter>;
  /** Called with the new filter, for a list that is filtered on the server. */
  onFilterChange?: (filter: RunLogFilter) => void;
  /** Rendered only when passed. Return a promise to show it loading. */
  onLoadMore?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  className?: string;
  classNames?: RunLogClassNames;
  /** Handy for overriding the --run-log-* theme vars inline */
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

const SECOND_MS = 1000;
const MINUTE_MS = 60_000;
const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;
const ALL_MODELS = "all";

    durationMs: 5900,
    id: "run-3",

    name: "How do rate limits work?",
    startedAt: Date.now() - MINUTE_MS * 3,
  },
  {
    costUsd: 0.04,
    durationMs: 2100,
    error: "Search docs failed: the index did not answer.",
    id: "run-2",
    model: "Model",
    name: "Where do I rotate an API key?",
    startedAt: Date.now() - MINUTE_MS * 18,
    status: "error",
  },
  {
    costUsd: 0.12,
    durationMs: 8400,
    id: "run-1",
    model: "Model",
    name: "Summarize yesterday's failed webhooks",
    startedAt: Date.now() - HOUR_MS * 2,
  },
];

const ENTER_CLASS =
  "fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-2 animate-in fill-mode-both duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:animate-none";

const THEME_VARS = [
  "[--run-log-accent:#1d6496] dark:[--run-log-accent:#6eb5dc]",
  "[--run-log-icon-bg:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--run-log-accent)_14%,var(--card))] dark:[--run-log-icon-bg:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--run-log-accent)_22%,var(--card))]",

  "[--run-log-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_1px_2px_-1px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08),0_2px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]",
  "dark:[--run-log-shadow:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.08)]",
  "dark:[--run-log-shadow-hover:0_0_0_1px_rgba(255,255,255,0.13)]",
].join(" ");

const FOCUS_CLASS =
  "focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80 focus-visible:outline-none";

/** Column widths the header and every row share. Model and Started give way when the list is narrow, as it is beside an open run. */
const MODEL_COLUMN =
  "hidden w-32 min-w-0 flex-none items-center gap-1.5 @md/run-log-list:flex";
const FIGURE_COLUMN = "w-14 flex-none text-right tabular-nums";
const STARTED_COLUMN =
  "hidden w-14 flex-none text-right tabular-nums @sm/run-log-list:block";

const toMs = (time: RunLogTime | undefined): number | null => {
  if (time === undefined) {
    return null;
  }
  const ms = new Date(time).getTime();
  return Number.isNaN(ms) ? null : ms;
};

/** `now`, `4m ago`, `3h ago`, `2d ago`, then the date. */
const formatStarted = (startedMs: number, now: number): string => {
  const since = now - startedMs;
  if (since < MINUTE_MS) {
    return "now";
  }
  if (since < HOUR_MS) {
    return `${Math.floor(since / MINUTE_MS)}m ago`;
  }
  if (since < DAY_MS) {
    return `${Math.floor(since / HOUR_MS)}h ago`;
  }
  if (since < DAY_MS * 7) {
    return `${Math.floor(since / DAY_MS)}d ago`;
  }
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
    day: "numeric",
    month: "short",
  }).format(new Date(startedMs));
};

const statusOf = (run: RunLogRun): RunLogStatus => run.status ?? "ok";

/** A running run without a duration counts up from when it started. */
const durationOf = (run: RunLogRun, now: number): number | null => {
  if (run.durationMs !== undefined) {
    return clean(run.durationMs);
  }
  const started = toMs(run.startedAt);
  return statusOf(run) === "running" && started !== null
    ? Math.max(0, now - started)
    : null;
};

type SortKey = "duration" | "cost" | "started";

interface Sort {
  key: SortKey;
  /** Largest or latest first. */
  descending: boolean;
}

const sortValue = (run: RunLogRun, key: SortKey, now: number): number => {
  if (key === "duration") {
    return durationOf(run, now) ?? -1;
  }
  if (key === "cost") {
    return run.costUsd ?? -1;
  }
  return toMs(run.startedAt) ?? -1;
};

/** Largest first, then smallest first, then back to the order it came in. */
const nextSort = (current: Sort | null, key: SortKey): Sort | null => {
  if (current?.key !== key) {
    return { descending: true, key };
  }
  return current.descending ? { descending: false, key } : null;
};

const countText = (count: number, noun: string): string =>
  `${count} ${noun}${count === 1 ? "" : "s"}`;

const STATUS_WORD: Record<RunLogStatus, string> = {
  error: "failed",
  ok: "finished",
  running: "running",
};

const EMPTY_TEXT: Record<RunLogStatusFilter, string> = {
  all: "No runs yet.",
  error: "No failed runs.",
  running: "Nothing is running.",
};

const ROW_KEYS: Record<string, (index: number, last: number) => number> = {
  ArrowDown: (index, last) => Math.min(index + 1, last),
  ArrowUp: (index) => Math.max(index - 1, 0),
  End: (_index, last) => last,
  Home: () => 0,
};

/** Ticks while it has something to count: every second with a run going, every minute without. */
const useNow = (live: boolean): number => {
  const [now, setNow] = useState(() => Date.now());

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(
      () => {
        setNow(Date.now());
      },
      live ? SECOND_MS : MINUTE_MS
    );
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
    };
  }, [live]);

  return now;
};

const Icon = ({
  icon,
  className,
}: {
  icon: IconSvgElement;
  className?: string;
}) => (
  <HugeiconsIcon
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn("size-3.5 flex-none", className)}
    icon={icon}
    strokeWidth={2}
  />
);

/** Nothing for a run that finished. Only a failure or a live run gets a mark. */
const StatusDot = ({ status }: { status: RunLogStatus }) => (
  <span
    aria-hidden="true"
    className="flex h-4 w-2 flex-none items-center justify-center"
  >
    {status === "ok" ? null : (
      <span
        className={cn(
          "size-1.5 rounded-full",
          status === "error"
            ? "bg-(--run-log-error)"
            : "animate-pulse bg-(--run-log-running) motion-reduce:animate-none"
        )}
      />
    )}
  </span>
);

interface StatusOption {
  id: RunLogStatusFilter;
  label: string;
  count: number;
}

const StatusSwitch = ({
  options,
  active,
  onChange,
}: {
  options: readonly StatusOption[];
  active: RunLogStatusFilter;
  onChange: (id: RunLogStatusFilter) => void;
}) => (
  <div
    aria-label="Status"
    className="inline-flex flex-none items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full bg-foreground/6 p-0.5"
    data-slot="run-log-status"
    role="group"
  >
    {options.map((option) => (
      <button
        aria-pressed={active === option.id}
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center gap-1 rounded-full border-0 px-2 text-xs leading-none font-medium transition-[background-color,color,box-shadow] duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
          FOCUS_CLASS,
          active === option.id
            ? "bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-(--run-log-shadow)"
            : "bg-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-card-foreground"
        )}
        key={option.id}
        onClick={() => {
          onChange(option.id);
        }}
        type="button"
      >
        {option.label}
        <span className="font-normal text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {option.count}
        </span>
      </button>
    ))}
  </div>
);

const ModelSelect = ({
  models,
  value,
  labelOf,
  onChange,
}: {
  models: readonly string[];
  value: string | null;
  labelOf: (model: string) => string;
  onChange: (model: string | null) => void;
}) => {
  const items = [
    { label: "All models", value: ALL_MODELS },
    ...models.map((model) => ({ label: labelOf(model), value: model })),
  ];
  return (
    <Select
      items={items}
      onValueChange={(next) => {
        onChange(typeof next === "string" && next !== ALL_MODELS ? next : null);
      }}
      value={value ?? ALL_MODELS}
    >
      <SelectTrigger
        aria-label="Model"
        className="ml-auto cursor-pointer gap-1 rounded-full border-0 bg-transparent py-0 pr-1.5 pl-2 text-xs leading-none text-muted-foreground shadow-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-foreground/6 hover:text-card-foreground data-popup-open:bg-foreground/6 data-popup-open:text-card-foreground data-[size=sm]:h-6 motion-reduce:transition-none dark:bg-transparent dark:hover:bg-foreground/6 [&_svg]:size-3"
        data-slot="run-log-model-filter"
        size="sm"
      >
        <SelectValue />
      </SelectTrigger>
      <SelectContent align="end" alignItemWithTrigger={false}>
        {items.map((item) => (
          <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
            {item.label}
          </SelectItem>
        ))}
      </SelectContent>
    </Select>
  );
};

const SortHeader = ({
  label,
  sortKey,
  sort,
  className,
  onSort,
}: {
  label: string;
  sortKey: SortKey;
  sort: Sort | null;
  className: string;
  onSort: (key: SortKey) => void;
}) => {
  const active = sort?.key === sortKey;
  let order = "";
  if (active) {
    order = sort.descending ? ", largest first" : ", smallest first";
  }
  return (
    <span className={className}>
      <button
        aria-label={`Sort by ${label.toLowerCase()}${order}`}
        className={cn(
          "-mr-1 inline-flex h-5 cursor-pointer items-center gap-0.5 rounded-[4px] border-0 bg-transparent px-1 text-xs leading-none transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:text-card-foreground motion-reduce:transition-none",
          FOCUS_CLASS,
          active ? "text-card-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground"
        )}
        onClick={() => {
          onSort(sortKey);
        }}
        type="button"
      >
        {active ? (
          <Icon
            className={cn(
              "size-3 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
              !sort.descending && "rotate-180"
            )}
            icon={ArrowDown02Icon}
          />
        ) : null}
        {label}
      </button>
    </span>
  );
};

/** What a screen reader hears for a row, in the order the columns read. */
const rowLabel = (
  run: RunLogRun,
  parts: {
    model: string | null;
    duration: string;
    cost: string;
    started: string;
  }
): string =>
  [
    run.name,
    STATUS_WORD[statusOf(run)],
    parts.model,
    parts.duration,
    parts.cost,
    parts.started,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");

export const RunLog = ({
  runs = DEFAULT_RUNS,
  title = "Runs",
  caption,
  labels,
  icons,
  selectedId,
  defaultSelectedId,
  onSelect,
  renderDetail,
  onClose,
  defaultFilter,
  onFilterChange,
  onLoadMore,
  className,
  classNames,
  style,
}: RunLogProps) => {
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<RunLogFilter>({
    model: defaultFilter?.model ?? null,
    status: defaultFilter?.status ?? "all",
  });
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<Sort | null>(null);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<string | null>(
    defaultSelectedId ?? null
  );
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const rowRefs = useRef(new Map<string, HTMLButtonElement>());

  const failed = runs.filter((run) => statusOf(run) === "error").length;
  const running = runs.filter((run) => statusOf(run) === "running").length;
  const now = useNow(running > 0);

  const labelOf = (model: string): string => labels?.[model] ?? model;
  const models = [
    ...new Set(runs.flatMap((run) => (run.model ? [run.model] : []))),
  ].toSorted((left, right) => labelOf(left).localeCompare(labelOf(right)));

  const statusOptions: StatusOption[] = [
    { count: runs.length, id: "all", label: "All" },
    ...(failed > 0 || filter.status === "error"
      ? [{ count: failed, id: "error" as const, label: "Failed" }]
      : []),
    ...(running > 0 || filter.status === "running"
      ? [{ count: running, id: "running" as const, label: "Running" }]
      : []),
  ];
  const showStatus = statusOptions.length > 1;
  const showModels = models.length > 1 || filter.model !== null;

  const changeFilter = (next: RunLogFilter) => {
    setFilter(next);
    onFilterChange?.(next);
  };

  const matching = runs.filter(
    (run) =>
      (filter.status === "all" || statusOf(run) === filter.status) &&
      (filter.model === null || run.model === filter.model)
  );
  const visible = sort
    ? matching.toSorted((left, right) => {
        const difference =
          sortValue(left, sort.key, now) - sortValue(right, sort.key, now);
        return sort.descending ? -difference : difference;
      })
    : matching;

  const selected = selectedId === undefined ? picked : selectedId;
  const pressable = Boolean(onSelect ?? renderDetail);
  const openRun =
    (renderDetail && runs.find((run) => run.id === selected)) || null;
  const openIndex = visible.findIndex((run) => run.id === openRun?.id);
  const priced = visible.filter((run) => run.costUsd !== undefined);
  const spent = priced.reduce((sum, run) => sum + clean(run.costUsd), 0);
  const filtered = visible.length !== runs.length;

  const select = (run: RunLogRun) => {
    setPicked(run.id);
    onSelect?.(run);
  };

  /** Puts the panel away and hands the keyboard back to the row it came from. */
  const close = () => {
    const row = openRun ? rowRefs.current.get(openRun.id) : undefined;
    setPicked(null);
    onClose?.();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      row?.focus();
    });
  };

  /** The run above or below the open one, in the order the list shows. */
  const neighbor = (offset: number): RunLogRun | undefined =>
    openIndex === -1 ? visible[0] : visible[openIndex + offset];

  const step = (offset: number) => {
    const next = neighbor(offset);
    if (next) {
      select(next);
      rowRefs.current.get(next.id)?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
    }
  };

  const onRowKeyDown = (
    event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
    index: number
  ) => {
    const next =
      visible[ROW_KEYS[event.key]?.(index, visible.length - 1) ?? index];
    if (!next || next === visible[index]) {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    rowRefs.current.get(next.id)?.focus();
    // With a run open, the arrows walk the panel through the list.
    if (openRun) {
      select(next);
    }
  };

  const loadMore = async () => {
    if (!onLoadMore || loading) {
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onLoadMore();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section
      aria-label={title}
      className={cn(
        THEME_VARS,
        "@container/run-log flex w-full max-w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground shadow-(--run-log-shadow) transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-(--run-log-shadow-hover)",
        className,
        classNames?.root
      )}
      data-slot="run-log"
      onKeyDown={(event) => {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && openRun && !event.defaultPrevented) {
          close();
        }
      }}
      style={style}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2",
          classNames?.header
        )}
        data-slot="run-log-header"
      >
        <span className="inline-flex size-6 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-(--run-log-icon-bg)">
          <Icon
            className="text-(--run-log-accent)"
            icon={LeftToRightListBulletIcon}
          />
        </span>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-none truncate text-[13px] leading-tight font-medium tracking-[-0.01em]">
          {title}
        </div>
        {caption ? (
          <span
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-right text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground"
            data-slot="run-log-caption"
          >
            {caption}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div
        className={cn("flex min-w-0", openRun && "h-[34rem]")}
        data-slot="run-log-body"
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            "@container/run-log-list min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-2",
            // On a narrow card the open run takes the list's place.
            openRun ? "hidden @2xl/run-log:flex" : "flex"
          )}
          data-slot="run-log-main"
        >
          {showStatus || showModels ? (
            <div
              className={cn(
                ENTER_CLASS,
                "flex min-h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 delay-75",
                classNames?.filters
              )}
              data-slot="run-log-filters"
            >
              {showStatus ? (
                <StatusSwitch
                  active={filter.status}
                  onChange={(status) => {
                    changeFilter({ ...filter, status });
                  }}
                  options={statusOptions}
                />
              ) : null}
              {showModels ? (
                <ModelSelect
                  labelOf={labelOf}
                  models={models}
                  onChange={(model) => {
                    changeFilter({ ...filter, model });
                  }}
                  value={filter.model}
                />
              ) : null}
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <div
            className={cn(
              ENTER_CLASS,
              "flex min-w-0 flex-col delay-100",
              openRun && "min-h-0 flex-1"
            )}
            data-slot="run-log-table"
          >
            <div
              className={cn(
                "flex h-7 min-w-0 items-center gap-3 px-1.5 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground shadow-[inset_0_-1px_0_0_var(--run-log-rule)]",
                classNames?.columns
              )}
              data-slot="run-log-columns"
            >
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 pl-4">Run</span>
              <span className={MODEL_COLUMN}>Model</span>
              <SortHeader
                className={FIGURE_COLUMN}
                label="Duration"
                onSort={(key) => {
                  setSort(nextSort(sort, key));
                }}
                sort={sort}
                sortKey="duration"
              />
              <SortHeader
                className={FIGURE_COLUMN}
                label="Cost"
                onSort={(key) => {
                  setSort(nextSort(sort, key));
                }}
                sort={sort}
                sortKey="cost"
              />
              <SortHeader
                className={STARTED_COLUMN}
                label="Started"
                onSort={(key) => {
                  setSort(nextSort(sort, key));
                }}
                sort={sort}
                sortKey="started"
              />
            </div>

            {visible.length === 0 ? (
              <p
                className="m-0 px-2 py-8 text-center text-[13px] leading-[1.45] text-pretty text-muted-foreground"
                data-slot="run-log-empty"
              >
                {filter.model === null
                  ? EMPTY_TEXT[filter.status]
                  : "No runs match these filters."}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <ul
                className={cn(
                  // The scrollbar sits in the gutter past the rows, so it never
                  // covers the Started column and the header stays lined up.
                  "m-0 -mr-2.5 flex list-none flex-col gap-px overflow-y-auto p-0 pt-1 pr-2.5 [scrollbar-width:thin]",
                  openRun ? "min-h-0 flex-1" : "max-h-[26rem]",
                  classNames?.list
                )}
                data-slot="run-log-list"
              >
                {visible.map((run, index) => {
                  const status = statusOf(run);
                  const durationMs = durationOf(run, now);
                  const startedMs = toMs(run.startedAt);
                  const duration =
                    durationMs === null ? "" : formatRunDuration(durationMs);
                  const cost =
                    run.costUsd === undefined ? "" : formatRunCost(run.costUsd);
                  const started =
                    startedMs === null ? "" : formatStarted(startedMs, now);
                  const model = run.model ? labelOf(run.model) : null;
                  const isSelected = run.id === selected;
                  const cells = (
                    <>
                      <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-2">
                        <StatusDot status={status} />
                        <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-px">
                          <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{run.name}</span>
                          {status === "error" && run.error ? (
                            <span
                              className="min-w-0 truncate text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground"
                              data-slot="run-log-error"
                              title={run.error}
                            >
                              {run.error}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </span>
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={cn(MODEL_COLUMN, "text-muted-foreground")}
                      >
                        {run.model && icons?.[run.model] ? (
                          <span
                            aria-hidden="true"
                            className="inline-flex size-3.5 flex-none items-center justify-center [&>svg]:size-3.5"
                          >
                            {icons[run.model]}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                        <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{model}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span
                        className={cn(
                          FIGURE_COLUMN,
                          status === "running" && "text-muted-foreground"
                        )}
                        suppressHydrationWarning
                      >
                        {duration}
                      </span>
                      <span className={FIGURE_COLUMN}>{cost}</span>
                      <span
                        className={cn(STARTED_COLUMN, "text-muted-foreground")}
                        suppressHydrationWarning
                      >
                        {started}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  );
                  const rowClass = cn(
                    "flex min-h-8 w-full min-w-0 items-start gap-3 rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent px-1.5 py-2 text-left text-[13px] leading-4 text-card-foreground transition-colors duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
                    classNames?.row
                  );
                  return (
                    <li data-slot="run-log-item" key={run.id}>
                      {pressable ? (
                        <button
                          aria-label={rowLabel(run, {
                            cost,
                            duration,
                            model,
                            started,
                          })}
                          aria-pressed={isSelected}
                          className={cn(
                            rowClass,
                            "cursor-pointer hover:bg-foreground/4",
                            FOCUS_CLASS,
                            isSelected &&
                              "bg-foreground/6 hover:bg-foreground/6"
                          )}
                          data-slot="run-log-row"
                          data-status={status}
                          onClick={() => {
                            select(run);
                          }}
                          onKeyDown={(event) => {
                            onRowKeyDown(event, index);
                          }}
                          ref={(element) => {
                            if (element) {
                              rowRefs.current.set(run.id, element);
                            } else {
                              rowRefs.current.delete(run.id);
                            }
                          }}
                          type="button"
                        >
                          {cells}
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <div
                          className={rowClass}
                          data-slot="run-log-row"
                          data-status={status}
                        >
                          {cells}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ul>
            )}
          </div>

          <div
            className={cn(
              ENTER_CLASS,
              "flex min-h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 delay-200",
              classNames?.footer
            )}
            data-slot="run-log-footer"
          >
            <output
              aria-live="polite"
              className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate pl-1.5 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground tabular-nums"
              data-slot="run-log-summary"
            >
              {filtered
                ? `${visible.length} of ${countText(runs.length, "run")}`
                : countText(runs.length, "run")}
              {priced.length > 0 ? ` · ${formatRunCost(spent)}` : null}
            </output>
            {onLoadMore ? (
              <Button
                className="rounded-full px-2.5"
                data-slot="run-log-more"
                disabled={loading}
                onClick={() => {
                  void loadMore();
                }}
                size="xs"
                type="button"
                variant="secondary"
              >
                {loading ? "Loading…" : "Load more"}
              </Button>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        </div>

        {openRun && renderDetail ? (
          <aside
            aria-label={`Run: ${openRun.name}`}
            className={cn(
              "flex w-full min-w-0 animate-in flex-col gap-2 duration-200 ease-out fade-in-0 slide-in-from-right-2 motion-reduce:animate-none @2xl/run-log:ml-3 @2xl/run-log:w-[min(27rem,52%)] @2xl/run-log:flex-none @2xl/run-log:pl-3 @2xl/run-log:shadow-[inset_1px_0_0_0_var(--run-log-rule)]",
              classNames?.detail
            )}
            data-slot="run-log-detail"
          >
            <div className="flex h-6 flex-none items-center gap-0.5">
              <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate pl-0.5 text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {openIndex === -1
                  ? "Not in this view"
                  : `${openIndex + 1} of ${visible.length}`}
              </span>
              <Button
                aria-label="Previous run"
                disabled={openIndex <= 0}
                onClick={() => {
                  step(-1);
                }}
                size="icon-xs"
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
              >
                <Icon icon={ArrowUp01Icon} />
              </Button>
              <Button
                aria-label="Next run"
                disabled={!neighbor(1)}
                onClick={() => {
                  step(1);
                }}
                size="icon-xs"
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
              >
                <Icon icon={ArrowDown01Icon} />
              </Button>
              <Button
                aria-label="Close run"
                data-slot="run-log-close"
                onClick={close}
                size="icon-xs"
                type="button"
                variant="ghost"
              >
                <Icon icon={Cancel01Icon} />
              </Button>
            </div>
            <div
              className="-mr-1.5 min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto pr-1.5"
              key={openRun.id}
            >
              {renderDetail(openRun)}
            </div>
          </aside>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
